The '''Muunilinst Banking Clan''' was a division of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]. The massive [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] project was funded by a conglomerate of factions, including the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], the Muunilinst Banking Clan, and the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]].<ref name="Complete Locations" />
